address: Grajska cesta 2, Otočec na Krki, 8222, Slovenia
bio: This luxury hotel and restaurant in a spectacular and tranquil location in the middle of the Krka river occupies a charming 13C castle that was demolished and then rebuilt for the purpose. Antiques, a delightful bar with a fireplace and soft comfortable sofas all combine to create the feel of bygone days in the attractive dining room. The cuisine is regional and traditional, featuring carefully prepared dishes and fresh vegetables sourced from the restaurant’s organic kitchen garden. Both the à la carte and the tasting menus follow the seasons. To round off your visit in truly aristocratic style, stay in one of the hotel’s luxurious guestrooms....
